BASE.name: ATTACK_VECTOR
BASE.justification: The payload is delivered in a request parameter over the network.

BASE.name: ATTACK_COMPLEXITY
BASE.justification: Placing markup in a reflected parameter is enough; no special conditions are needed.

BASE.name: PRIVILEGES_REQUIRED
BASE.justification: No account is needed to craft the malicious link.

BASE.name: USER_INTERACTION
BASE.justification: The victim must open the crafted link.

BASE.name: SCOPE
BASE.justification: The script runs in the victim browser, outside the vulnerable server.

BASE.name: CONFIDENTIALITY
BASE.justification: The script can read session cookies and page content in the victim browser.

BASE.name: INTEGRITY
BASE.justification: The script can make limited changes to the page or act as the user.

TEMPORAL.name: EXPLOIT_CODE_MATURITY
TEMPORAL.justification: The vulnerability class is well documented and proof-of-concept exploits exist.

TEMPORAL.name: REMEDIATION_LEVEL
TEMPORAL.justification: The rule description documents the secure coding fix.

TEMPORAL.name: REPORT_CONFIDENCE
TEMPORAL.justification: The issue is identified by data-flow analysis from source to sink.
